# Webix Solutions

> Webix Solutions builds websites, custom CRM software, client portals and AI workflows. It also provides search and marketing services and white-label delivery for agencies.

## Services

- [Website design and development](https://webixsolutions.com/web-design-development-service/): custom websites and builds using WordPress, Shopify, Webflow and Framer.
- [SEO, AEO and GEO](https://webixsolutions.com/seo-services/): technical SEO, local search and content that answers customers’ questions.
- [Custom CRM and client portals](https://webixsolutions.com/custom-crm-development/): lead pipelines, booking dashboards, customer portals and internal tools.
- [AI automation](https://webixsolutions.com/ai-automation-services/): customer intake, support assistants and workflow integrations.
- [White-label agency partnerships](https://webixsolutions.com/white-label-partners/): project delivery for agency partners.

## Work and booking

- [Portfolio](https://webixsolutions.com/our-work/)
- [Camz Cleaning](https://webixsolutions.com/our-work/camz-cleaning-booking/)

The team works remotely from Pakistan and serves Canada, the United States, the UAE, New Zealand and Pakistan.
